name: Boss Encounter Script
description: The contract a boss fight fulfils: engage on arena entry, phase changes on health thresholds, arena lock while engaged, clean resolution either way. utility.behavior_fsm owns the generic state machine and could express any one boss; this component owns the encounter semantics every boss shares, so 'seal the doors at engage, drop the reward at defeat' is written once and varied by data, not re-scripted per fight. It does not own the boss's attacks — those are combat.melee_basic or combat.hotbar_abilities on the boss entity — and it does not own the loot, which inventory.loot_table and inventory.affix_loot_generator roll after combat.entityDefeated like any other kill, only louder.

inputs.name: phaseThresholds
inputs.description: Health fractions where the phase flips. Two thresholds is the classic three-act fight; the array is the whole design surface.

inputs.name: lockArenaOnEngage
inputs.description: Whether the arena seals when the fight starts. Locking commits the player; unlocked arenas invite kiting the boss backwards through the dungeon, which is a genre break.

inputs.name: enrageTimerSeconds
inputs.description: Soft enrage after which the fight gets lethal. Zero disables it; without an enrage, patient builds turn every boss into a timer test of the player's bladder, not skill.

outputs.name: currentPhase
outputs.description: Zero-based phase index, for AI and arena consumers.

outputs.name: engaged
outputs.description: True from arena entry until defeat or party wipe.
